Q8095.reason: A secure five-month-old is in the indiscriminate sociability phase and unlikely to have stranger anxiety, whereas the 2-month-old is also sociable but the 5-month-old with secure base is most reliably attaching, while the older infants show stranger wariness or insecure attachment.
